tagline: North America's largest deathcare provider with Dignity Memorial brand
hero_kpi_rationale: The $17.0 billion future revenue backlog from preneed funeral and cemetery sales provides remarkable visibility into future revenues and demonstrates the predictable stability of cash flow.

kpis.name: Future Revenue Backlog
kpis.explanation: Future revenues from preneed deathcare goods and services sales (trust and insurance)
kpis.description: The future revenue backlog is a key indicator of the company's financial health and its ability to generate stable, predictable long-term revenues.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of future revenue stability and predictability

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash flow generated by funeral services and cemetery operating activities
kpis.description: Operating cash flow of $942.8 million demonstrates the company's ability to generate recession-resistant cash flow and fund its operations.
kpis.signal: Fundamental financial strength and operational management flexibility

kpis.name: Current Maturities of Long-Term Debt
kpis.explanation: Amount of long-term debt maturing within the next 12 months
kpis.description: Current maturities of long-term debt of $56.8 million reflect a favorable maturity profile and the company's ability to effectively manage its capital structure.
kpis.signal: Prudent management of debt maturity profile

kpis.name: Leverage Ratio
kpis.description: The leverage ratio of 3.67x is consistent with industry financing standards and the strategic target of 3.5x to 4.0x, demonstrating balanced capital structure management.
kpis.signal: Positioning within the 3.5x to 4.0x leverage target

kpis.name: Quarterly Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Quarterly dividend paid to common shareholders
kpis.description: The quarterly dividend of $0.34 per share represents consistent growth since 2005 ($0.025) and demonstrates the company's commitment to rewarding shareholders while maintaining a prudent capital structure.
kpis.signal: Commitment to shareholder returns with consistent growth since 2005

kpis.name: Number of Funeral Service Locations Operated
kpis.explanation: Number of funeral service locations operated by the company in North America
kpis.description: The network of 1,485 funeral service locations represents the largest geographic coverage in the industry and provides the capacity to serve approximately 700,000 families annually under the Dignity Memorial brand.
kpis.signal: Leading geographic scale and unmatched network in North America

kpis.name: Number of Cemeteries Operated
kpis.explanation: Number of cemeteries operated by the company including combined funeral services/cemetery sites
kpis.description: The portfolio of 500 cemeteries (including 312 combined funeral services/cemetery sites) across 44 states, 8 Canadian provinces and other territories provides a substantial asset platform for memorialization services.
kpis.signal: Geographically diversified real estate asset portfolio in North America

kpis.name: Acquisition Investments
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in acquiring funeral service and cemetery sites
kpis.description: Acquisition investments of $101.3 million in 2025 (22 funeral service sites and 2 cemeteries) reflect the selective growth strategy and continued portfolio optimization in areas offering attractive returns.
kpis.signal: Continued growth strategy through targeted acquisitions and new site construction

kpis.name: Common Stock Repurchases
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in repurchasing company common stock
kpis.description: Stock repurchases of $464.2 million in 2025 (5.86 million shares at $79.15 per share) represent an 85.9% increase compared to 2024 and reflect the commitment to returning excess cash flow to shareholders.
kpis.signal: Capital return to shareholders with significant increase in repurchases

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.34 last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.184 billion last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 33.8% last year.

kpis.name: Earnings per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average diluted shares outstanding for the fiscal year. Allows visualization of the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for calculating the Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Market Conditions Affecting Trust Fund Investments
risks.summary: Trust fund returns (14.7%, 12.3%, 16.5% for 2025, 2024, 2023) are exposed to financial market volatility that could reduce investment gains and affect client returns.
risks.score_rationale: Trust funds related to preneed funeral services and cemetery property sales hold investment portfolios (stocks, bonds, mutual funds) affected by market conditions beyond the company's control

risks.title: Demographic Trends and Mortality Rates
risks.summary: Demographic changes could affect the number of deaths and demand for deathcare services, although the current trend toward cremation offers complementary service opportunities.
risks.score_rationale: Population growth, average age and mortality rates are key but largely external factors affecting demand for funeral and cemetery services

risks.title: Trust Fund Credit Risk Exposure
risks.summary: Bond and credit instrument investments in trust funds could suffer losses if issuers experience credit difficulties, affecting the value of trust assets.
risks.score_rationale: Trust funds hold credit security investments (bonds, fixed income funds) that expose the company to issuer credit default risks

risks.title: Inflation Risk and Operating Costs
risks.summary: Rising labor, merchandise and property maintenance costs could reduce profit margins if the company cannot fully pass these costs through via pricing.
risks.score_rationale: Inflation could increase wage costs, funeral merchandise costs and operating costs for funeral and cemetery sites
